driverNotes.note: USCDI is not a FHIR package. 45 CFR 170.213 requires USCDI v3 since January 1, 2026 (v1 expired); SVAP adds v4, v5 and v6, which travel with US Core 7.0.0, 8.0.x and 9.0.0.

Authentication also requires OpenID Connect Core 1.0 (170.215(e)(1)), refresh tokens valid at least three months, revocation within one hour at the patient's direction, and token introspection ((g)(10)(v)–(vii)). None of these are FHIR packages.

HTI-5 (proposed December 29, 2025; not final as of this KB) would delete the expired US Core 3.1.1 and SMART 1.0.0 paragraphs and make USCDI v3.1 the only USCDI version. It would not change the (g)(10) text.
The Inferno (g)(10) test kit v8.0.7 tests US Core 6.1.0 and 7.0.0 only; ONC says test tools gain the 2026 SVAP versions by December 31, 2026.
